name: Kudou Akihito
source:
A second-year student. He used to be a member of the drama club but has since quit. He’s an ordinary young man, except that his delicate features led him to be cast in female roles, which in turn drew dangerous advances from male students. 

He performs at an average level in both sports and academics. His parents are celebrities who are often away on business trips overseas. Due to a scheme hatched by Yuri, Nano, and Meiko, he ends up moving in with them.

Although he was troubled by Yuri and Nano’s confessions of love, he is, after all, a boy, and his honest body ends up accepting this lewd lifestyle.

While he harbors some wariness toward Meiko, the fact that he accepts the high-performance, homemade sex toys she provides shows he’s completely hooked.
